description: Generic browser and computer control, built from scratch in this seed, modelled on the ChatGPT cua pattern but not a copy of OpenAI code. This is not WebMCP page tools: it controls Chrome tabs through the Chrome debugging port and Mac apps through the accessibility adapter, for apps the user enabled, local only. In dry-run mode it touches nothing, and in Mac mode it needs the debugging port for tab state and Accessibility permission for app control.
name: cua

tools.description: Get the current computer state: mode, running apps, and Chrome tabs if the debugging port is reachable, else tabs unavailable with the port instruction.
tools.name: get_state

tools.description: List Chrome tabs through the debugging port at 127.0.0.1:9222. Error if the port is unreachable, never a pretend tab list.
tools.name: list_tabs

tools.description: Open a Chrome tab with a URL. In Mac mode it uses the debugging port first, and falls back to opening Chrome with the URL if the port is unreachable, saying plainly which route was used.
tools.name: create_tab

tools.description: Get one Chrome tab by tab id or by a URL substring, through the debugging port. Error if the port is unreachable or no tab matches.
tools.name: get_tab

tools.description: Open a Mac app by name. In dry-run mode this records only, no app is opened.
tools.name: open_app

tools.description: Click at screen coordinates x and y in a Mac app. Requires confirmation for risky targets, and needs Accessibility permission in Mac mode.
tools.name: click

tools.description: Type text into a Mac app. Sensitive data transmission requires pre-approval or confirmation, and the text is never logged.
tools.name: type_text
